name: AlarmsBellButton
description: Top-bar bell button with a three-line severity badge (critical / high / medium). Counts are caller-provided so the button stays domain-agnostic; derive them from whatever alerts route your app serves
descriptionFull:
Top-bar bell button with a three-line severity badge (critical / high / medium). Counts are caller-provided so the button stays domain-agnostic; derive them from whatever alerts route your app serves.

`onClick` fires for the bell itself; pass `onSeverityClick` to make each count its own button (severity-filtered deep-link). The two are independent — clicking a severity does not also fire `onClick`

props.name: counts
props.description: Severity-bucketed alarm counts rendered in the stacked badge

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler — typically opens an alerts panel or routes to /alerts

props.name: onSeverityClick
props.description: Click handler for an individual severity count. When provided, each badge row becomes its own button so an operator can…
props.descriptionFull: Click handler for an individual severity count. When provided, each badge row becomes its own button so an operator can jump straight to the alerts page filtered by that severity (e.g. `/alerts?severity=critical`). When omitted, the counts render as plain (non-interactive) text

fields.name: critical
fields.description: Critical alarm count, shown as the top badge row; omit to hide the row

fields.name: high
fields.description: High alarm count, shown as the middle badge row; omit to hide the row

fields.name: medium
fields.description: Medium alarm count, shown as the bottom badge row; omit to hide the row
